title: Water Instead
can_do: 在行动尚未完成前自然地改变选择。
trigger: Mom is about to pour the first drink choice, and the child changes their mind in time.
core_response: Actually, can I have water instead?
stretch_response: I changed my mind. Can I have water instead?
essential_props: two drink choices and an empty cup

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Milk or water in your cup?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Sure. I am about to pour it.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Actually, can I have water instead?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Of course. I have not poured it yet. Here is your water.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Thanks. Water is what I want now.

replay_cards.title: Switch the fruit
replay_cards.change: Change from an orange to an apple before the bag closes
replay_cards.challenge: Mom checks the new choice, swaps it, and closes the bag

replay_cards.title: Switch the bedtime book
replay_cards.change: Change from the train book to the bear book
replay_cards.challenge: Dad has opened the first cover but has not started; ask to switch and begin the new story

parent_support: Pause before pouring so there is a real chance to change the choice.
Treat changing one's mind as ordinary when the action is still easy to change.
